text.title: FreshDrop weekly plan, 20 families, September 2026
text.hypothesis: families with 2+ children in Moscow pay for a fixed slot, because they miss the courier now
text.assumption: families will pay 149 rub for a slot; if not, nothing else matters
text.real: a paid slot order in the app
text.manual: the team books slots by hand in a spreadsheet; the ops lead confirms each order
text.skip: the weekly plan, the loyalty points and the SMS reminders
text.metric: share of paid slot orders; confirmed at 8% of cart checkouts
text.result: 41 paid orders (6.1%); feedback: «the slot is what I need»; the 8% target was not reached
text.decision: change the price to 129 rub and repeat for 2 weeks; decision on 1 October 2026
